messages:
zoe_marketing: Quick sync - "Tiny Plugin Starter" execution. Deliverables: one-file refapp, 15m tutorial vid, 1-paragraph benchmark blurb, 45m community stream. Target publish next Wed 11:00 PT. Who can own which piece?

max_devrel: I can take the refapp + tutorial. Idea: tiny plugin scaffold that calls embeddings + tool-call. Keep repo to one file and minimal deps so community can fork quickly.

indra_engineer: Ill run benches. Two modes: interactive (<=512 tokens) and context-heavy (>=2048). Will report p50/p95 and cost/1k tokens. Need ~200 prompts from Max.

rachel_growth: Ill do landing + signup funnel. Map signups -> HubSpot list "Tiny Plugin Starter" and tag utm_campaign=tiny_plugin_starter. CTA options: Run Live / Register. Planning email + X + Dev Forum posts day after launch.

ci-bot: Content calendar slot reserved Wed 11:00. Preview site: https://tiny-plugin-preview.redwood.dev (internal). Drafts due Mon EOD.

max_devrel: Repo skeleton pushed: `tiny_plugin.py` with README and one-line run: `python tiny_plugin.py --model open-mini`. Adding a try-it curl for hero: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"open-mini\",\"prompt\":\"Summarize...\"}'`.

indra_engineer: First bench draft: interactive p50=50ms p95=200ms; context p50=230ms p95=700ms. Uploaded CSV of prompts+responses. Will write 1-paragraph bench blurb highlighting latency vs cost tradeoffs.

rachel_growth: Figma landing v1 up. Two CTAs wired. I'll hook form -> HubSpot webhook -> Zapier fallback -> SFDC. Hidden field: `source=tiny_plugin_webinar`. Social plan: email launch + X + community forum thread.

zoe_marketing: Owners confirmed: repo+tutorial Max; bench Indra + Zoe; landing Rachel; ops Max for webinar runbook. Publish Wed 11:00 PT, social blast Thu 09:00 PT.

max_devrel: Ill also add a 1-slide arch diagram and a 6-step demo script to README. Asking someone to monitor GPU during the live stream.

zoe_marketing: Please paste preview links, final assets, and recording notes into this thread by Tue EOD. If blockers, flag now so we can reassign.
